text:
alex.sales: Heads-up: MerchantX POC will ramp tomorrow 09:00 PST. We expect a short but sharp spike -- asking ops for a temporary reserved uplift + tighter burst cooldown. Need access plan and rough cost calc.

ria.eng: What peak QPS / avg tokens? Region?

alex.sales: Roughly 120 QPS peak for ~2 hours, avg ~1,000 tokens per request. Region: us-west2.

juan.ops: Ok. Proposal: add +6 reserved GPUs to the dedicated pool for 48h and reduce burst cooldown from 30m -> 5m so we can spin up burst capacity faster. Will also set canary fallback to the smaller 7B model if capacity hits 90%.

katie.se: Sounds reasonable. I need a ballpark cost delta to sign off. Billing-bot, can you estimate additional cost for +6 GPUs for 48h (on Dedicated pricing) including burst credits?

billing-bot: Estimated incremental cost: $6 GPUs * 48 hours * $3.25/hr (reserved rate) = $936. Burst credit buffer + routing costs add ~ $120. Total ~ $1,056. Overages billed monthly unless prepaid.

katie.se: Ok approved up to $1.2k for this POC window. Proceed. :thumbsup: 

ria.eng: Two operational notes: 1) We need ephemeral API keys for MerchantX demo team; generate with 48h TTL and restrict to the pool. 2) If they are in a VPC peering test, we must update the IP allowlist for the dedicated pool.

juan.ops: I can handle keys and allowlist. Need MerchantX CIDR and the owner email for compliance. Also want to run the resize during a quiet minute to avoid API storms -- recommend 08:15 PST today.

alex.sales: CIDR sent to you via DM. Owner is elena@merchantx.com. 08:15 PST works.

deploy-bot: Running dry-run for pool update: 
```
redwoodctl pools update --pool merchantx-demo --reserved-gpus 6 --burst-cooldown 300 --canary-threshold 0.9 --duration 48h
```
Dry-run OK. Will schedule execution at 08:15 PST upon explicit go.

ria.eng: Also add prefix KV-caching for MerchantX routes to reduce token costs during steady-state. Suggest ttl=30m for caches of repeated prompts.

juan.ops: Noted. Will apply cache config post-resize.

katie.se: Quick security Q: MerchantX asked about KMS key separation for logs and artifacts. Can we confirm logs remain in Redwood-managed KMS and not exported?

ria.eng: For hosted Dedicated we use customer-managed KMS optionally. For this demo we will use Redwood-managed keys; logs and audits will be viewable in Console but not exported. If they need CMK, we can enable but provisioning takes ~2 business days.

alex.sales: MerchantX is fine with Redwood-managed for the demo. Thanks. One last ask: can we shorten the cooldown earlier if traffic subsides?

juan.ops: Yes, we'll monitor and can rollback the reserved headroom and restore original cooldown early. I will post status updates in this thread.

alex.sales: Perfect. Pls confirm once the reserved GPUs are live.

juan.ops: Scheduled resize executed at 08:15 PST. Reserved GPUs live at 08:19 PST. Burst cooldown set to 300s. Canary fallback to 7B model enabled. Monitoring dashboards pinned to MerchantX routing view.

alex.sales: MerchantX confirms traffic spike handled, latency within SLOs. Closing loop -- thanks everyone. :party-popper:
